rv.q: Instead, its clear-sighted sense of the high stakes of history is what makes it so deeply moving.
But Cable Street is too full of ideas and decent melodies to ever be dull for long.
Ultimately, Cable Street remains a powerful piece of theatre.
Cable Street may not pass with flying colours, but it still just about manages to scrape through.
Some rough edges remain, especially if Cable Street is to play in a larger venue, but there is much to celebrate in this significant new work.
The 2 hour and 35 minute running time hardly flies by.

cn.t: Critics find Cable Street an ambitious, heartfelt show about solidarity and resistance that mostly succeeds despite some flaws, with praise for its thematic resonance and score.
